offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures fluid handling equipment, including pumps, meters, dispensing and spray systems for moving, measuring, controlling and applying fluids and coatings. Sells mainly to industrial, contractor and vehicle service customers through a global distributor network.

primary_products.value: pumps; spray and dispensing equipment; fluid meters and valves; paint and coating application equipment; lubrication equipment

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial manufacturers, painting and construction contractors, vehicle service shops, oil and gas and process companies

end_markets.value: industrial manufacturing; construction; automotive service; oil and gas; food and beverage

revenue_model.value: product sales: equipment, parts and accessories sold via distributors and direct

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures fluid handling equipment from purchased materials and components, sold to distributors and industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: industrial, process and contractor fluid handling equipment sharing technology and channels

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent industrial, paint, construction and lubrication distributors; direct sales: OEM and large industrial accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules plus product safety and explosion-proof certifications such as ATEX
